title: School Bell
blurb: Harsh, unmusical, and in charge of childhood for over a century. The bell triggers something deep in anybody who has ever had a locker: an involuntary urge to stand up and leave, entirely regardless of what is currently being said. That reflex does not decay with age, which is why playing it midway through a meeting produces grown adults visibly beginning to pack up before they have caught themselves. Also excellent for edits about escapes, deadlines and freedom, all three of which it has always meant simultaneously.
